system.description: You are so tied to the Shadowlands that you are forced to interact with the world of the dead nightly, even while in the world of the living. Ghostly walls may impede your movement, ghostly objects may strike you, and wraiths' powers work on you as if you stood on the far side of the Shroud — wraiths can affect you directly, inflicting damage without any special means. You cannot see into the Shadowlands without another Merit or power to grant it, so you must feel your way blindly and may be restricted by immaterial terrain at the Storyteller's discretion. Typically, a Narrator manifests this inconvenience once per game session, automatically failing one of your actions (retests and overbids notwithstanding) — for example, being blocked by a ghostly wall or having an attack disrupted by an unseen wraith. Appropriate only for games with frequent wraith interaction.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
